dataset.title: Wireline logging data from Hole FDB-1 penetrated throughof the Futagawa fault, SW Japan

FDB-1_wireline_original.tab.role: Unmodified complete published 3646-row table, including metadata, empty fields and lithological remarks

units.depth: m, original borehole logging depth; no conversion to true vertical depth/elevation
units.sonic_velocity: km/s in source; m/s in exported VP

coordinates.horizontal_crs: Not explicitly named in source; do not assign an EPSG code
coordinates.vertical_datum: Not explicitly named; retain source depth axis

missing_values: 138 rows lack depth and are retained in the original table but excluded from LAS; no inferred depths. Empty numerical fields become LAS NULL=-999.25 / NaN, never zero.
processing: Select every row with a provided depth; preserve order and all 3508 valid depth positions, including gaps.
Export temperature, calipers, gamma, sonic VP and derived DT; preserve sonic remark-present flag as a separate numeric curve and retain all remark text in original table.
LAS STEP=0 declares an irregular depth sequence; no resampling or gap filling.

Only adjacent original 0.1 m pairs with finite positive VP and no sonic remark contribute to the representative unflagged interval-time diagnostic; report covered depth rather than crossing missing/flagged intervals.
uncertainty: No per-sample measurement errors are published. The 0.00001 km/s decimal reporting increment only bounds quantization; it is not total sonic accuracy or a geological confidence interval.
model_assumption: Integrate local sonic slowness along the published borehole-depth coordinate only for accepted adjacent intervals. This is a one-dimensional interval diagnostic, not an observed seismic travel time, surface-to-depth well tie, or true-vertical-depth conversion.
limitations: Source lithological remarks are retained, not automatically classified as faulty measurements.
This case does not estimate Archie water saturation, mineral fractions, depth below sea level or fault displacement.
The LAS is a clearly labelled format/unit conversion of actual measured logs, not an original instrument LAS delivery.
